description.value:
Usage drawn on a slashing or piercing weapon

The jagged shape of this rune resembles a vampire's fangs. Strikes with the rune-bearing weapon deal an additional @Damage[(3 + floor((@actor.level - 9) / 2))[void]] damage. Whenever a living creature is damaged by one of these Strikes, the rune-bearer gains temporary Hit Points equal to the void damage the target took (after applying resistances and the like). These temporary Hit Points last 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-runesmith-assistant.pf2e-runesmith-assistant-items.Item.gwPN3jbKrnuCI3eA]{Effect: Cruonign, Rune of Leeching}

Invocation The rune lashes out in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] from the wielder of the weapon, dealing @Damage[(4 + floor((@actor.level - 9) / 2))d10[void]] damage to each creature in the area, with a basic Fortitude save. If any creatures take damage, the wielder regains @Damage[(12 + floor((@actor.level - 9) / 2) * 3)[healing]] Hit Points.

Level (+2) The additional void damage increases by 1, the damage of the invocation increases by 1d10, and the healing increases by 3.
